definitions.explanation: The essential meaning or most important points of a text, speech, or argument.

examples.japanese: ⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{要旨|ようし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write a summary of the thesis.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{要旨|ようし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: I summarized the gist of the meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{要旨|ようし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{以下|いか}→以下：01294_ika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The summary of the statement is as follows.

examples.japanese: ⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{要旨|ようし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{三行|さんぎょう}→三行：noentry⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦まとめて→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please summarize the gist of the article in three lines.

examples.japanese: ⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{要旨|ようし}⟦だけ→だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{読|よ}めば→読む：00426_yomu⟧、⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦だいたい→だいたい：00831_daitai⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: If you just read the summary of the report, you can get a general idea of the overall content.

notes:
{要旨|ようし} means the gist or essential points of a text, speech, or argument. Composed of ⟦{要|よう}→要：10000_you⟧ (essential) + ⟦{旨|し}→旨：noentry⟧ (purport, meaning). Common in academic, legal, and formal business contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {要旨|ようし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめる→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧: to summarize the main points
- {要旨|ようし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧: to explain the gist
- ⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{要旨|ようし}: thesis abstract
- ⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{要旨|ようし}: summary of remarks

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {要旨|ようし}: gist, main purport (formal, emphasizes core meaning)
- ⟦{概要|がいよう}→概要：06747_gaiyou⟧: outline, overview (broader, more general)
- ⟦{要約|ようやく}→要約：14128_youyaku⟧: summary, abstract (condensed version of a text)
- ⟦{要点|ようてん}→要点：01668_youten⟧: key point(s) (specific important items)
- ⟦{趣旨|しゅし}→趣旨：05629_shushi⟧: purpose, intent (why something was done/said)
